sloka: अयं शरस्त्वमोघस्ते दिव्यः परपुरञ्जयः ।अनेन लवणं सौम्य हन्ता ऽसि रघुनन्दन ।। ७.६३.१९ ॥
transliteration: ayaṁ śarastvamoghaste divyaḥ parapurañjayaḥ ।anena lavaṇaṁ saumya hantā 'si raghunandana ।। 7.63.19 ॥

translations.english: O gentle Shatrughna, this divine arrow of yours is unfailing and capable of conquering enemy cities; with this, you will surely kill Lavana.
